verdict.rationale: React's own docs include a structured API reference (createRoot, hydrateRoot, 'use client' pages with documented options like onUncaughtError and identifierPrefix) and an editable in-browser sandbox ('Try editing this sandbox!'). However, the evidence never shows runnable sandboxes embedded in the reference pages themselves; the sandbox is cited only on the installation page. missing for 10: evidence that API reference entries contain interactive runnable examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive reference experience.
